description:
**Severity: high · Dimension: test-conventions** (report finding #4)

Five `SimulationRunner` tests in `crates/gf2-coding/tests/modem_analysis_integration.rs` have `max_frames` of 4,000-8,000 and no `#[ignore]` annotation, so they exceed the 5 s CI per-test hard-kill budget on every run. Per AGENTS.md, tests calling `SimulationRunner`/`run_curve`/`run_coded` with `max_frames > 50` MUST carry `#[ignore = "sim: ..."]`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: All five affected tests carry `#[ignore = "sim: <descriptive reason>, N frames"]`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The fast tier (`cargo nextest run -p gf2-coding --release --profile ci`) completes these as ignored and stays within the 60 s wall-clock / 5 s per-test budget.
- [hard] REQ-03: No other test in the file regresses; fmt passes.
title: Mark SimulationRunner modem-analysis integration tests as ignored
